# MouseTester
> Browser-based mouse diagnostics. Check buttons, scrolling, polling rate, double-click issues, DPI, and more.

MouseTester is a comprehensive suite of free, web-based tools for diagnosing and testing computer mice. 

## Features
- Complete Mouse Test: General testing for mouse buttons and functionality.
- Double Click Test: Check if your mouse is suffering from double-click issues.
- Polling Rate Test: Measure the Hz of your mouse.
- Scroll Wheel Test: Check your mouse wheel scrolling consistency.
- DPI Test: Analyze the Dots Per Inch (DPI) of your mouse.
- Debounce Test: Guide and test for mouse debouncing.
- CPS Test: Clicks Per Second speed test.
- Drag & Hold Test: Test if your mouse struggles with holding a click (drag dropping).
- Accuracy Test: Test your cursor accuracy.

## Access
All tools are available directly in the browser without any software installation.
